== English Reflections III comparison ==
Contemporary 27 October 2001 prerelease reports name this Lord Maul in play. The earlier Decipher broadcast says “Maul,” which could refer to the earlier card foiled in this product. Retail followed on 31 October. The replacement phrases Disarmed as an explicit prohibition while retaining the clash and attrition immunities. The Naboo deployment, combat and loss modifiers remain.
